impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while if self.use_the_first_consumer_for_this_block {
            &self.first_consumer_of_the_lane
        } else {
            &self.second_consumer_of_the_lane
        }
        .has_records()
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
